verdict.rationale: SigNoz's GitHub describes a free, open-source edition that runs in your own infrastructure via Docker, Kubernetes, or Linux, and the docs call it an open-source observability platform. Community users discuss self-hosting it as an alternative to Datadog, which corroborates that self-hosting is real and in use. missing for 10: a lighter or simpler self-host footprint (users report too many containers and services to reconfigure), Windows install support (a Rancher Desktop attempt failed on sh/bash dependencies), and clarity on which features sit under the separately licensed 'ee/' open-core directory.
